Lucy Verigin was interviewed by her daughter, Violet Gellenbeck (K'ilisët). The recording was made by Sharon Hargus at Lucy's home in Terrace.

This text was mostly translated by Mabel Forsythe and Lillian Morris, and mostly transcribed by Sharon Hargus, with help from Lillian Morris.
